about: A free, open-source stand-in for Amazon's cloud services, for testing apps on your own machine.

prs.title: Range queries from the AWS Python library work again
prs.broken: Asking the database for a range of records with the AWS Python library failed with an error saying the main key was missing, because the library wraps the question in brackets.
prs.changed: The check now looks inside brackets before deciding whether the main key is there, as the real Amazon database does.
prs.matters: Code that searches by date or order range runs the same against the test copy as in production.
